## Invitations

The outreach activity generated 1801 invitations. A total of 1192 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 66.2. This indicates that the invitation process resulted in participation from a substantial proportion of those invited. Attendance was lower during winter and recovered in spring, providing a useful context for reviewing engagement across the period. The figures offer a clear summary of invitations issued and attendance recorded.

## Contact

SMS was used as a contact method for 1553 invitations. A further 1553 people received a reminder message. The matching totals show the scale of text-message contact and reminder activity associated with the outreach. These communications supported the invitation process by providing recipients with information and a subsequent prompt. The contact figures should be considered alongside attendance when reviewing the overall reach of the activity.
